headline: China Factory Activity Contracts in October as Recovery Falters
summary: Manufacturing activity in China contracted in October, reflecting persistent headwinds in the country's economic recovery.
why: China is the world's second-largest economy and a primary driver of global manufacturing trade and commodity demand.

impacts.name: China
impacts.why: Contraction in October factory activity points to renewed weakness in industrial output.
